title: Certified Policy Optimisation for Nested Causal Bandits via PAC-Bayes Risk
abstract: arXiv:2605.29788v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Critical sequential decisions are rarely single-timescale: a strategic decision causally shapes the context in which every subsequent tactical choice is made; standard bandit and reinforcement-learning theory does not capture this causal coupling between timescales. We formalise the problem class as Nested Contextual Causal Bandits (NCCBs), a hierarchical SCM where each level's action sets the next level's context distribution, and propose Nested Causal Thompson Sampling (NCTS), which draws one mechanism-factorised belief per episode and acts recursively under it. Our main theoretical result is a causal PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound that certifies any candidate deployment policy from historic data alone, off-policy and anytime, answering the deployment question: can we trust this agent here, and at what risk? translated_title: 基于PAC-Bayes风险的嵌套因果老虎机认证策略优化
translated_abstract: 关键性序贯决策很少是单一时间尺度的：一个战略性决策会因果性地塑造后续每一个战术性选择所处的情境；标准的赌博机和强化学习理论无法捕捉这种时间尺度之间的因果耦合。我们将该问题类别形式化为嵌套上下文因果老虎机，这是一个分层结构因果模型（SCM），其中每一层的动作决定下一层的情境分布；并提出嵌套因果汤普森采样，它在每个回合抽取一个机制分解的信念，并在该信念下递归地行动。我们的主要理论结果是一个因果PAC-Bayesian超额风险界，仅凭历史数据即可对任何候选部署策略进行认证，支持离策略（off-policy）和随时（anytime）使用，从而回答部署问题：我们能否在此处信任这个智能体，其风险有多大？在分层SCM上的实验表明，与在同一函数类别上匹配的RFF-GP联合回归相比，该因子化方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出嵌套上下文因果老虎机（NCCB）这一分层因果决策问题框架及嵌套因果汤普森采样（NCTS）算法，其核心贡献是一个因果PAC-Bayesian超额风险界，可仅凭历史数据、离策略且随时地对任意候选部署策略进行认证，回答“能否信任该智能体、风险多大”的部署问题。
en_tdlr: This paper formalises Nested Contextual Causal Bandits (NCCBs), proposes Nested Causal Thompson Sampling (NCTS), and derives a causal PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound that certifies any candidate deployment policy from historic data alone, off-policy and anytime.
